= Tables: cols= and Cell Alignment

== Width-only cols

[cols="1,3,1"]
|===
| Narrow | Wide centre that gets the lion's share | Narrow
| A | B | C
|===

== Alignment per column

[cols="<,^,>"]
|===
| left | centre | right
| 1    | 2      | 3
|===

== Width + alignment

[cols="<2,^1,>1"]
|===
| Mostly text         | Mid | End
| more text over here | x   | y
|===

== Repeat shorthand `3*<`

[cols="3*<"]
|===
| one | two | three
| 1   | 2   | 3
|===

== Per-cell alignment overrides column

[cols="<,<,<"]
|===
| col-default     ^| centred override     >| right override
| col-default     | col-default           | col-default
|===
